name: particle-image
title: Particle Image
blurb: Image breaks into particles that react to cursor movement with physics…
description: Renders an image as animated particles responding to cursor proximity. Physics-based simulation with configurable gravity, particle size, and motion behavior.
use_when: Interactive hero sections or playful displays where particle effects create visual engagement and dynamism.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive devices — particle physics simulation can be GPU-intensive.
a11y: Particle animation is visual only; no semantic content or keyboard interaction.
